2609.00427.title: SpecMind: Enabling Spectrum Intelligence via Multi-Agent Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2609.00427.paper_summary: The exponential growth of wireless devices is driving unprecedented spectrum demand, pushing spectrum management toward more fine-grained decisions across space, time, and device constraints. As a result, spectrum policymakers and engineers must process large volumes of data that come from diverse sources and take many different forms, such as text and tables. These data sources are often disaggregated and require significant time and effort to integrate, search, and interpret. Furthermore, most of this information is formatted for human understanding and is not readily accessible to automated systems. To address this challenge, we propose SpecMind, a novel Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for spectrum intelligence that performs reasoning over heterogeneous data sources. This system enables autonomous agents to coordinate specialized sub-agents that retrieve and synthesize knowledge across policy proceedings, legal regulations, and license databases. We develop SpecBench, a question and answer (Q&A) dataset based on real-world license records and policy proceedings, addressing the lack of evaluation resources for RAG systems in the spectrum domain. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecMind outperforms traditional, general-purpose RAG systems across spectrum-related tasks, achieving over 80% win rate against strong baselines. The agent-based design enables more accurate retrieval, better contextual reasoning, and improved task completion across diverse query types.
2609.00427.paper_summary_zh: 無線設備的指數增長正在推動前所未有的頻譜需求，促使頻譜管理朝向在空間、時間和設備限制上進行更精細的決策。<lb/>因此，頻譜政策制定者和工程師必須處理來自多樣來源的大量數據，這些數據呈現出多種不同的形式，例如文本和表格。<lb/>這些數據來源通常是分散的，並且需要大量的時間和精力來整合、搜索和解釋。<lb/>此外，這些信息大多是為人類理解而格式化的，對自動化系統來說並不容易訪問。<lb/>為了應對這一挑戰，我們提出了SpecMind，一個新穎的多代理檢索增強生成（RAG）系統，用於頻譜智能，能夠對異構數據來源進行推理。<lb/>該系統使自主代理能夠協調專門的子代理，檢索和綜合政策程序、法律法規和許可數據庫中的知識。<lb/>我們開發了SpecBench，一個基於現實世界許可記錄和政策程序的問答（Q&A）數據集，以解決頻譜領域中RAG系統缺乏評估資源的問題。<lb/>實驗結果表明，SpecMind在頻譜相關任務上超越了傳統的通用RAG系統，對強基準的勝率超過80%。<lb/>基於代理的設計使得檢索更準確、上下文推理更佳，以及在多樣查詢類型下的任務完成度提升。
